content.short: Militereum is a Web3 firewall for EVM-compatible wallets.
content.description: Militereum delivers a powerful Web3 firewall that runs on Windows and macOS, designed to block suspicious transactions before they reach your wallet. It works with any EVM-compatible wallet, whether browser-based or desktop, giving you a consistent layer of protection across all your apps. Built-in support spans Ethereum and a broad range of chains, including Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and others, helping you monitor and shield activity across active networks.
